# FDG7006

> DO document all exceptions thrown by publicly callable members because of a violation of the member contract (rather than a system failure) and treat them as part of your contract.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.1 Exception Throwing.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: the contract is for the callers of publicly callable members, outside the library. Analyzer candidate rejected: which exceptions are contract violations rather than system failures is judgment, and exceptions thrown by called members are not visible to a syntax check.

## From the book

Exceptions that are a part of the contract should not change from one version to the next (i.e., the exception type should not change, and new exceptions should not be added).
